LFT 2026: 48-h week (Art. 59 as reformed DOF 01-05-2026, transitory art. 2: 48 h in 2026, 46 in 2027, 44 in 2028, 42 in 2029, 40 in 2030) on 6 × 8 h days (Arts. 61, 69). 2026 has 365 − 52 Sundays = 313 working days; − 7 obligatory rest days falling on weekdays (Art. 74: 1 Jan, 2 Feb, 16 Mar, 1 May, 16 Sep, 16 Nov, 25 Dec) − 12 days vacation (Art. 76, first year; +2 a year to 20, then +2 per 5 years) = 294 days × 8 h = 2,352 h
items.notes: The 40-h reform cuts this to ≈ 1,960 h by 2030 at the same weekly pay — a 20% rise in the hourly cost by 2030. Cross-check: ILOSTAT ENOE manufacturing actual hours 2025 = 43.61 h/wk × 52 = 2,268 h. official/holidays.json lists 9 MX dates incl. Maundy Thursday and Good Friday, which are NOT Art. 74 rest days.
